title: Materialize adversarial semantic-core Phase A baseline

before.state: ADV-001 through ADV-005 existed only as a failure-first design document
before.evidence: No executable tests recorded the current engine's unsupported semantic capabilities

after.state: ADV-001 through ADV-005 are executable Go tests that explicitly record UNSUPPORTED without weakening the existing R0 oracle tests
expected: ADV-003 declarative rules with provenance: UNSUPPORTED
ADV-005 observation runtime separated from transition: UNSUPPORTED

invariants: Unsupported capability is not reported as PASS
No semantic implementation is added in Phase A
No expected final semantic answer is smuggled into fixtures
Phase B may replace an UNSUPPORTED gate only with an executable semantic assertion

impact.downstream: Phase B is now gated by executable unsupported baselines

notes: This change intentionally makes missing capabilities visible without making CI fail merely because restoration has not happened yet. A future implementation must convert each gate from UNSUPPORTED to a real semantic PASS with provenance.
